say:0:1710317101:0.text: Watch out for these creatures here!
say:0:1710317101:0.source_cn: 这里有一些魔法怪物，梅林阁下，请小心。
say:0:1710317101:0.male: Watch out for these creatures here!
say:0:1710317101:0.female: Watch out for these creatures here!

say:1:1710317102:0.text: They must be part of the exhibition hall's defense system. When it comes to the crunch, we'll have to take them out.
say:1:1710317102:0.source_cn: 看起来像是展览馆的安保措施，必要时我们得消灭它们。
say:1:1710317102:0.male: They must be part of the exhibition hall's defense system. When it comes to the crunch, we'll have to take them out.
say:1:1710317102:0.female: They must be part of the exhibition hall's defense system. When it comes to the crunch, we'll have to take them out.
